scripts.text: - Carrying too many items, cannot proceed. -
The waiting time for a {0} collection quest has expired. You can now take another request.
The waiting time for storing {0} Energy Crystals has expired. You can now store them again.

[Reno]
Hi? I am Reno from the Energy Crystal Research Association, or ECRA.

[Reno]
ECRA is the institute that researches '^0000FFEnergy Crystals^000000' that shall be used as an alternative energy source in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, which suffers from a shortage of energy.

[Reno]
I would like to explain that we are not trying to make an excuse to get away from facing problem before I explain the reason. Never! So please let me finish.

[Reno]
The Research Team has sent me the results they found.

[Reno]
Energy Crystals turned out to be ^0000FFgenerated inside the bodies of some monsters^000000, and according to the research, stronger monsters generate higher-class energy crystals in their bodies.

[Reno]
The Research Team decided to collect Energy Crystals by giving requests to adventurers, with appropriate rewards. That enables us to collect better and be more ^FF0000efficient^000000.

[Reno]
Energy Crystals, accumulated through hunting monsters by my request, shall be used for my research. ^0000FFSome of them are planned to be returned to adventurers.^000000

[Reno]
Adventurers can use collected Energy Crystals for ^FF0000upgrading equipments^000000 through me.

[Reno]
If it works well, it seems to be good for both ECRA and adventurers.

[Reno]
The hunting quests are ranked by monster level and difficulty. The ranges are lower, intermediate, high quests and can only be taken once per day.

[Reno]
I am sorry but the request for the {0} collection is only available for those level {1} and higher. You do not seem to be capable of carrying out this request.

[Reno]
You seem to be under the other request of {0} collection. If the quest seems to be too hard... how about you ^FF0000give up on the request^000000?

[Reno]
Currently waiting for the {0} collection commission. Tasks in each collection can only be completed once per day.

[Reno]
You selected to hunt a monster from the {0} collection. After hunting these monsters you will receive {1}^0000FF{2} Energy Crystals^000000 when you return to me.

[Reno]
Please select the monster that you think you can easily hunt from the list.

[Reno]
I am sorry but the request for the most advanced collection is only available for those level {0} and higher. You do not seem to be capable of carrying out this request.

[Reno]
The request for {0} collection monsters has been issued. Please check the details on the issued document.

[Reno]
You are currently under the request of the {0} collection. If you give up now, all your history will be lost. Do you really want to give up?

[Reno]
You are not under any request.

[Reno]
The written request for you has been withdrawn.

[Reno]
Do you want to accumulate Energy Crystals inside of your body to receive a buff?

[Reno]
Energy Crystals are accumulated in your body when you hunt the monsters we ask you to.

[Reno]
Our research shows that some methods enable humans to accumulate the energy crystals inside of the body in the form of a buff.

[Reno]
If you spend about 3 hours, you will be able to gain a small amount of Energy Crystals. So do you want to receive the buff?

[Reno]
Were you successful? While storing other Energy Crystals will not have much effect on your body, storing the same one may cause you harm.

[Reno]
With a body like that, you can't accumulate {0} Energy Crystals. You must be level {1} or your body will be harmed in the process.

[Reno]
Accumulating Energy Crystal has already begun. I am sorry but it is impossible to accumulate two different types of Energy Crystals at a time.

[Reno]
An error has occurred. Please forgive me for the inconvenience.

[Reno]
It takes 3 hours for your body to accumulate 2 to 4 {0} Energy Crystals. Do you want to start?

[Reno]
I recommend that you try to ccumulate Energy Crystal when you have time.

[Reno]
You might feel a slight tingle.

[Reno]
Everything seems to be in order. Let's start accumulating {0} Energy Crystals. Remember to come back to me after 3 hours to get the {1} Energy Crystals.

[Reno]
Do you want to compress the Energy Crystals?

[Reno]
Are you curious about Energy Crystal compression? I can compress lower level Energy Crystals into higher ones.

[Reno]
Here is what I can make.
^FF000010 Rough Energy Crystals^000000 = ^FF00001 Purified Energy Crystal^000000
^FF00005 Purified Energy Crystals^000000 = ^FF00001 High Energy Crystal^000000

[Reno]
If you need higher grade Energy Crystals, this is a good way to get them since the lower ones are easier to get.

[Reno]
Okay, please contact if you need me in the future.

[Reno]
The compression was very successful.
There are {0} Energy Crystals left, which can compress into {1} Energy Crystals. Do you want to continue?

[Reno]
Do you want to exchange Energy Crystals for equipment? Please select the type of Energy Crystal that you wish to exchange.

[Reno]
This is the brochure regarding the equipment upgrade that our Energy Crystal research association provides. Please take a look around.

[Reno]
Please select the equipment to exchange for {0}s.

[Reno]
The materials to make a Safety Ring[1] are insufficient. Please check your inventory.

[Reno]
Before upgrading your Safety Ring, please listen to these ^FF0000precautions^000000.

[Reno]
^FF0000In addition to the Safety Ring, all refinements and cards of the required materials will also disappear.^000000

[Reno]
The materials are insufficient. Please check your materials.

[Reno]
Before upgrading your equipment, please listen to these ^FF0000precautions^000000.

[Reno]
^FF0000When using Energy Crystals to upgrade equipment, all previous refinements, enchantments, and cards will be lost.^000000

[Reno]
The upgrade was successful. Your Energy Crystals will help our research greatly.

[Reno]
Do you want to donate Energy Crystals to get a random new headgear?

[Reno]
We are collecting Energy Crystals so that we can research more combinations of headgears for adventurers.

[Reno]
Thanks to the support of adventurers we can use these Energy Crystals to further our research.

[Reno]
So we receive a minimum of 300 Rough Energy Crystals, 600 Purified Energy Crystals, and 900 High Energy Crystals.

[Reno]
You may feel that this is a burden, but for the sake of our research, please continue.
For the donation, I'll give you a random new headgear.

[Reno]
300 Rough Energy Crystals
- New Mage Hat
- New Magician Hat
- New Kitsune Mask
- New Joker Jester
- New Bunny Band
- New Munak Hat
- New Bongun Hat
- New Phantom Opera Mask

[Reno]
600 Purified Energy Crystals
- Good Binoculars
- Good Fin Helm
- Good Assassin Mask
- Good Welding Mask
- Good Safety Ring
- Good Angelic Protection
- Good Angelic Guard
- Good Angelic Cardigan
- Good Angel's Reincarnation

[Reno]
900 High Energy Crystals
- Enhanced Corsair
- Enhanced Bone Helm
- Enhanced Helm of Angel
- Enhanced Variant Shoes
- Enhanced Ring of Flame Lord
- Enhanced Ring of Resonance

[Reno]
Thank for your support, but we need 300 Rough Energy Crystals.

[Reno]
Thank for your support, but we need 600 Purified Energy Crystals.

[Reno]
Thank for your support, but we need 900 High Energy Crystals.

[Reno]
Thank you very much. The Energy Crystals you donated will be greatly helpful for our research. This is your reward for your donation.

[Reno]
This is the brochure regarding the equipment upgrade that our Energy Crystal research association provides. Please take a look around.
You receive {0} {1}s as the {2} collection reward.
